title: D-091 T7: resource fit for 5 loop lanes on the 4 CPU / 8 GB cloud server (memory ceiling under 70%, global review/combine limit)
objective: Tune the loop's fail-closed resource limits for a shared 4 CPU / 8 GB Linux server running 5 lanes: a memory pause ceiling under 70% of physical memory (about 5.6 GiB on this server, derived from the measured total rather than hard-coded), a global limit of at most 2 concurrent review-or-combine processes across all lanes, and per-lane caps, keeping every existing fail-closed gauge. The PC defaults stay as they are; the Linux values are documented in the example config.
business_reason: Owner directive D-091: move the loop to the cloud server with Codex and Claude reviews and a combining model.
inputs: owner rule D-090-R076: keep memory under 70%; if it gets close, drop to 4
outputs: Linux resource limits and the global review/combine limit in config.py/run_budget.py/resource_sampling.py with tests
config.example.toml documents the Linux values beside the PC values
forbidden_paths: the real controller config outside the repo
raising any limit above its current PC value on Windows
starting or commissioning a live loop, or any owner-typed step (runbook section 12)
codex login or handling any owner credential
weakening any fail-closed check, gate, reviewer-independence rule or the orchestrator's sole authority (ADR-005)
Windows behavior changes: existing Windows paths and tests must keep passing unchanged
other D-091 tasks' paths (M0-T166: launch_seam.py, linux/, cli.py, capability_probe.py, native_runtime.py)
acceptance_scenarios: primary: on a host reporting 8 GiB total memory the pause ceiling resolves to no more than 70% of it; at or above it the loop pauses (fail closed)
boundary: a third concurrent review-or-combine request waits (or is refused) while two are running; per-lane caps hold
missing/ambiguous: unreadable memory or CPU gauges fail closed (pause), never run unbounded
regression: the Windows/PC defaults and every existing resource test are unchanged
risks: recertification: every tools/agent_supervisor/** edit invalidates the frozen certification; one recertification task runs after all D-091 code tasks
